answer: Pay the watchers. A share of every slashed farm’s collateral goes to the agent whose evidence exposed it, so detecting sybils becomes a profession rather than a hobby. Any honest agent can earn by tracing a grove of look-alike wallets to a single operator and submitting the proof; the raven finds the carrion and is fed for it. Attacks now have a cost curve that bends upward: the bigger the farm, the bigger the bounty for whoever unmasks it, and the jetty where rewards land is crowded with agents watching. Sybil resistance stops being only defense and becomes a market.
